# NEW 2026-11-21 v7.0 Wave 1 Package 3, Playable Rus' Phase 1 (1337-1480, oe_rpl_). Generated by gen_rus_playable.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Safely adjust oe_rpl_defiance clamped to 0..100.
oe_rpl_add_defiance = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_rpl_defiance } } set_variable = { name = oe_rpl_defiance value = 15 } }
    change_variable = { name = oe_rpl_defiance add = $amount$ }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_rpl_defiance min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# Country scope. Advance oe_rpl_reform_level monotonically to $lvl$.
oe_rpl_set_reform = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_rpl_reform_level } } set_variable = { name = oe_rpl_reform_level value = $lvl$ } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_rpl_reform_level < $lvl$ } set_variable = { name = oe_rpl_reform_level value = $lvl$ } }
}

# Country scope. Initialize a human Rus' player's Phase 1 state variables once.
oe_rpl_bind_player = {
    save_scope_as = oe_rpl_tmp_player
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rpl_player value = scope:oe_rpl_tmp_player }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_rpl_path } } set_variable = { name = oe_rpl_path value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_rpl_stage } } set_variable = { name = oe_rpl_stage value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_rpl_defiance } }
        if = { limit = { OR = { tag = NOV tag = PSK } } set_variable = { name = oe_rpl_defiance value = 25 } }
        else_if = { limit = { tag = KIE } set_variable = { name = oe_rpl_defiance value = 20 } }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_rpl_defiance value = 15 } }
    }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_rpl_yoke_broken } } set_variable = { name = oe_rpl_yoke_broken value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_rpl_councils_held } } set_variable = { name = oe_rpl_councils_held value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_rpl_reform_level } } set_variable = { name = oe_rpl_reform_level value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_rpl_civil_war_outcome } } set_variable = { name = oe_rpl_civil_war_outcome value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_rpl_ecc_stance } } set_variable = { name = oe_rpl_ecc_stance value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_rpl_phase1_done } } set_variable = { name = oe_rpl_phase1_done value = 0 } }
}

# Any scope. One-time initialization of the Playable Rus' Phase 1 line.
oe_rpl_init_line = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rpl_init value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rpl_end value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rpl_sent_cnt value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { current_year < 1485 }
        culture_group:russian_group = {
            random_country_in_culture_group = {
                limit = { oe_rpl_eligible = yes }
                oe_rpl_bind_player = yes
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_rpl_has_live_player = yes }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_rpl_on value = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_rpl_end value = 8 }
        }
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_rpl_end value = 8 }
    }
}

# Country scope (the tracked human Rus' country). Monthly defiance drift and yoke-break detection.
oe_rpl_sync_defiance = {
    oe_rpl_add_defiance = { amount = oe_rpl_defiance_drift }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { var:oe_rpl_yoke_broken ?= 1 }
            OR = {
                NOT = { exists = international_organization:tatar_yoke }
                AND = { current_year >= 1450 NOT = { country_exists = c:GLH } }
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_rpl_yoke_broken value = 1 }
    }
}

# Public monthly entry point (scheduler slot 44 on BYZ, OR human Rus' fallback pulse when BYZ is absent).
# Strictly idempotent within the same calendar month via oe_rpl_ran_m.
oe_rpl_monthly = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rpl_m value = oe_rpl_m_now }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_rpl_ran_m ?= global_var:oe_rpl_m } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_rpl_ran_m value = global_var:oe_rpl_m }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_rpl_init } }
            oe_rpl_init_line = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                global_var:oe_rpl_end ?= 8
                current_year < 1485
                oe_rpl_eligible = yes
            }
            oe_rpl_bind_player = yes
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_rpl_end value = 0 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_rpl_on value = 1 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rpl_on }
            if = {
                limit = { current_year >= 1485 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_rpl_end value = 3 }
                remove_global_variable = oe_rpl_on
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { oe_rpl_has_live_player = yes }
                global_var:oe_rpl_player = {
                    if = {
                        limit = { is_ai = yes }
                        remove_global_variable = oe_rpl_on
                        set_global_variable = { name = oe_rpl_end value = 8 }
                    }
                    else = {
                        oe_rpl_sync_defiance = yes
                        oe_rpl_dispatch_events = yes
                    }
                }
            }
            else = {
                # Re-bind if the human Rus' tag formed RUS (e.g. MOS -> RUS) during Phase 1.
                if = {
                    limit = { country_exists = c:RUS c:RUS = { is_ai = no } }
                    c:RUS = {
                        oe_rpl_bind_player = yes
                        set_variable = { name = oe_rpl_phase1_done value = 1 }
                    }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rpl_end value = 2 }
                    remove_global_variable = oe_rpl_on
                }
                else = {
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rpl_end value = 8 }
                    remove_global_variable = oe_rpl_on
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Public bidirectional hook for gen_ecclesia.py (.52/.57/.58/.59):
# Call from BYZ scope (after scope:oe_ecc_rus_host is saved) to mirror the Rus' metropolitanate crisis onto a human Rus' player.
oe_rpl_on_ecc_bridge = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = scope:oe_ecc_rus_host
            scope:oe_ecc_rus_host = { is_ai = no oe_rus_country = yes religion = religion:orthodox }
            NOT = { global_var:oe_rpl_fired_30 ?= 1 }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_rpl_fired_30 value = 1 }
        scope:oe_ecc_rus_host = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_rpl.30 }
    }
}

oe_rpl_job_11 = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_rpl_path value = 1 }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_rpl_stage } } set_variable = { name = oe_rpl_stage value = 1 } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_rpl_stage < 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_rpl_stage value = 1 } }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_rpl_p1_kalita_purse years = 15 mode = replace }
}

        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_rpl_stage } } set_variable = { name = oe_rpl_stage value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_rpl_stage < 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_rpl_stage value = 2 } }

oe_rpl_job_71 = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_rpl_defiance value = 100 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_rpl_yoke_broken value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_rpl_stage value = 4 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_rpl_phase1_done value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_rpl_end value = 1 }
        remove_global_variable = oe_rpl_on
        if = {
            limit = {
                exists = international_organization:tatar_yoke
                is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:tatar_yoke
                NOT = { is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:tatar_yoke }
            }
            international_organization:tatar_yoke = { remove_country_from_international_organization = { country = root } }
        }
        add_prestige = 25
        add_stability = 10
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_rpl_yoke_shattered years = 15 mode = replace }
}

            c:LIT.union = { remove_country_from_international_organization = { country = root } }
        }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_rpl_kiev_independent years = 15 mode = replace }
}

oe_rpl_test_start = {
    oe_rpl_test_clear = yes
    oe_rpl_bind_player = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rpl_init value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rpl_on value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rpl_end value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rpl_sent_cnt value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rpl_m value = oe_rpl_m_now }
}

oe_rpl_test_month = {
    remove_global_variable = oe_rpl_ran_m
    oe_rpl_monthly = yes
}

oe_rpl_test_set_path = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_rpl_on } } oe_rpl_test_start = yes }
    set_variable = { name = oe_rpl_path value = $path$ }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_rpl_stage < 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_rpl_stage value = 1 } }
}

oe_rpl_test_def80 = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_rpl_on } } oe_rpl_test_start = yes }
    set_variable = { name = oe_rpl_defiance value = 80 }
}
